parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom module of the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the default module is exported.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModelVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the Thing Specification Language model to retrieve. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest published version is returned.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product.

You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query the ProductKey.
